-- ============================================================
-- JOB MARKET INTELLIGENCE | GOLD V2
-- Synapse Serverless SQL (Built-in) | baza: job_market
-- Nie zmienia Gold v1 ani dbo.vw_job_snapshots.
-- ============================================================

-- Uruchom w Synapse Studio z kontekstem bazy job_market.
-- Skrypt korzysta z uprawnien Microsoft Entra / ADLS aktualnego uzytkownika.

-- ============================================================
-- 1. WIDOKI GOLD V2 (3 tabele biznesowe)
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_job_snapshots_v2 AS
SELECT
    REPLACE(jobs.filepath(1), 'snapshot_date=', '') AS snapshot_date,
    jobs.*
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stjobmarketdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/jobs/v2/fact_job_snapshots/snapshot_date=*/*.parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS jobs;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_job_skills_v2 AS
SELECT
    REPLACE(skills.filepath(1), 'snapshot_date=', '') AS snapshot_date,
    skills.*
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stjobmarketdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/jobs/v2/bridge_job_skills/snapshot_date=*/*.parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS skills;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_job_locations_v2 AS
SELECT
    REPLACE(locations.filepath(1), 'snapshot_date=', '') AS snapshot_date,
    locations.*
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stjobmarketdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/jobs/v2/bridge_job_locations/snapshot_date=*/*.parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS locations;
GO

-- ============================================================
-- 2. WIDOK MANIFESTU (kontrola zakonczonych dni)
--    Nie jest czwarta tabela biznesowa; to metadane ETL.
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_gold_v2_commits AS
SELECT
    manifest.snapshot_date,
    manifest.run_id,
    manifest.job_count,
    manifest.skill_count,
    manifest.location_count
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stjobmarketdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/jobs/v2/_manifest/snapshot_date=*/*.parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS manifest;
GO

-- ============================================================
-- 3. RAPORT KONTROLNY: liczby i manifest dla kazdego dnia
-- ============================================================

WITH fact_counts AS (
    SELECT snapshot_date, COUNT_BIG(*) AS fact_rows
    FROM dbo.vw_job_snapshots_v2
    GROUP BY snapshot_date
),
skill_counts AS (
    SELECT snapshot_date, COUNT_BIG(*) AS skill_rows
    FROM dbo.vw_job_skills_v2
    GROUP BY snapshot_date
),
location_counts AS (
    SELECT snapshot_date, COUNT_BIG(*) AS location_rows
    FROM dbo.vw_job_locations_v2
    GROUP BY snapshot_date
)
SELECT
    m.snapshot_date,
    m.run_id,
    m.job_count AS expected_jobs,
    f.fact_rows,
    m.skill_count AS expected_skills,
    s.skill_rows,
    m.location_count AS expected_locations,
    l.location_rows,
    CASE WHEN m.job_count = f.fact_rows
           AND m.skill_count = s.skill_rows
           AND m.location_count = l.location_rows
         THEN 'OK' ELSE 'CHECK' END AS count_status
FROM dbo.vw_gold_v2_commits AS m
LEFT JOIN fact_counts AS f ON f.snapshot_date = m.snapshot_date
LEFT JOIN skill_counts AS s ON s.snapshot_date = m.snapshot_date
LEFT JOIN location_counts AS l ON l.snapshot_date = m.snapshot_date
ORDER BY m.snapshot_date;
GO

-- ============================================================
-- 4. SPRAWDZENIE DUPLIKATOW (wynik pusty = brak duplikatow)
-- ============================================================

SELECT 'fact' AS dataset, job_snapshot_key, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS item_index, COUNT_BIG(*) AS occurrences
FROM dbo.vw_job_snapshots_v2
GROUP BY job_snapshot_key
HAVING COUNT_BIG(*) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'skills', job_snapshot_key, CAST(skill_index AS BIGINT), COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.vw_job_skills_v2
GROUP BY job_snapshot_key, skill_index
HAVING COUNT_BIG(*) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'locations', job_snapshot_key, CAST(location_index AS BIGINT), COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.vw_job_locations_v2
GROUP BY job_snapshot_key, location_index
HAVING COUNT_BIG(*) > 1;
GO

-- ============================================================
-- 5. SKILLS: TOP 20 (wszystkie dni / wystapienia, nie unikalne oferty)
-- ============================================================

SELECT TOP 20 skill_name, COUNT_BIG(*) AS occurrences
FROM dbo.vw_job_skills_v2
GROUP BY skill_name
ORDER BY occurrences DESC;
GO

-- ============================================================
-- 6. POWER BI: GRANT SELECT DLA ISTNIEJACEGO UZYTKOWNIKA
--    Uruchom po utworzeniu widokow, w bazie job_market.
--    Brak CREATE USER: uzytkownik zostal juz utworzony.
-- ============================================================

GRANT SELECT ON OBJECT::dbo.vw_job_snapshots_v2
TO [powerbi-reader@adamablergmail.onmicrosoft.com];

GRANT SELECT ON OBJECT::dbo.vw_job_skills_v2
TO [powerbi-reader@adamablergmail.onmicrosoft.com];

GRANT SELECT ON OBJECT::dbo.vw_job_locations_v2
TO [powerbi-reader@adamablergmail.onmicrosoft.com];
GO

-- UWAGA: powyzsze widoki czytaja wszystkie dostepne partycje Parquet.
-- Manifest sluzy do weryfikacji, ale same widoki nie filtruja
-- automatycznie niekompletnych dni. Zanim udostepnisz nowe daty
-- Power BI, wymagaj poprawnego manifestu dla tych dat.
